mapper.sql: g.cd_grp_id, g.cd_grp_nm, g.cd_grp_se_cd, g.attr1_nm, g.attr2_nm, g.attr3_nm, g.sort_seq, g.use_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmn.cd_dtl d WHERE d.cd_grp_id = g.cd_grp_id) AS code_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cmn.cd_grp g ORDER BY g.sort_seq, g.cd_grp_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.cd_dtl ( cd_grp_id, dtl_cd, cd_nm, attr1_val, attr2_val, attr3_val, sort_seq, use_yn, aply_bgn_dt, created_by ) VALUES ( #{row.cdGrpId}, #{row.dtlCd}, #{row.cdNm}, #{row.attr1Val}, #{row.attr2Val}, #{row.attr3Val}, #{row.sortSeq}, #{row.useYn}, #{row.aplyBgnDt}, #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT} )
